title: Meatballs in Tomato Sauce
subtitle: Italian-style beef meatballs in a rich tomato sauce
excerpt: Beef meatballs made with parmesan and garlic, browned and simmered in a basil tomato sauce. Serve with pasta or bread to catch the sauce.
sourceNotes: Synthesised from Italian-American meatball traditions. Using egg yolks rather than whole eggs keeps the meatballs tender rather than firm.

recipe.freezeNotes: Freeze cooked meatballs in sauce for up to 3 months. Defrost overnight in the fridge and reheat on the hob.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Shape and chill the raw meatballs up to 24 hours ahead.

content.text: Mix the meatball mixture as little as possible. Overworking the mince makes the meatballs dense.

items.prepNote: 3 cloves minced into meatballs, 3 cloves sliced for the sauce
half into the sauce, half to serve

content.text: Mix the beef mince with the egg yolks, parmesan, 3 minced garlic cloves, and a generous pinch of salt and pepper. Mix briefly with your hands until just combined.
Roll the mixture into balls about the size of a golf ball. You should get 16 to 20. Set them on a plate.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a wide frying pan over medium-high heat. Brown the meatballs in batches, turning every 2 minutes until browned all over. Remove and set aside.
In a large saucepan, heat the remaining oil over medium heat. Cook the onion for 5 minutes until soft. Add the 3 sliced garlic cloves and tomato puree. Stir for 1 minute.
Pour in the tinned tomatoes. Add half the basil. Season well. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the meatballs to the sauce. Spoon the sauce over them. Cover and simmer on low heat for 15 minutes.
Taste and season. Scatter the remaining basil over the top.

items.symptom: Meatballs are falling apart in the sauce.
items.cause: Not browned enough before adding to sauce.
items.fix: Brown all sides until a crust forms before transferring.
Mix only until the ingredients just come together.

items.cause: Tomatoes not cooked long enough to sweeten.
items.fix: Simmer the sauce for at least 10 minutes before adding meatballs.
